summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd furnished a Form 6-K reporting unaudited condensed consolidated financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, including a balance sheet and statement of operations. Total assets were $36.44 million versus $32.72 million at December 31, 2025; current liabilities rose to $10.51 million, including a $6.88 million repurchase forbearance liability and $1.10 million of convertible notes. The filing is a routine interim earnings disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for going-concern and liquidity risk, given accumulated deficit trends and a reverse-split-adjusted share count of 1,152,607.
